pages.text: $(l)Ancient City / Jungle Temple$()$(br)Ancient Cities favor Hollow Eye, Shroud of the Forsaken, Eye of the Sleepless Witness, Tablets of Stillness and Coveting, Oblivion Stone, the Knell of the Forsworn, Elixir of Eternal Dusk, and a rare Key of the Sealed Abyss. Jungle Temples lean toward Hollow Eye, Eye of the Sleepless Witness, Tablets of Stillness and Coveting, and Oblivion Stone.

$(l)Strongholds$()$(br)Libraries favor Censer of Hollow Prayer, Eye of the Sleepless Witness, Oathbound Reliquary, tablets, the Knell of the Forsworn, and the Elixir of Eternal Dusk. Support loot favors Gravebell Locket, Mourner's Thread, Nebula Lens, Censer of Hollow Prayer, and one of the current sources of Brandkeeper's Mercy.

$(l)End / Trial / Nether$()$(br)End Cities are one of the current sources of Brandkeeper's Mercy, alongside void-bound relics, the Key of the Sealed Abyss, and Oblivion Stone. Ominous Trial rewards can also yield Brandkeeper's Mercy. Nether and Bastion loot lean toward ash, judgment, penance, martyrdom, and last-breath relics, plus the Chalice of the Bloodsworn, Phial of Quenched Embers, and Scourgeborne Amulet.

$(l)Ruins, Trials & the Sea$()$(br)Trail Ruins and Trial Chambers can yield the Clot of Stubborn Ichor. Woodland Mansions hide the Chalice of the Bloodsworn. Desert Pyramids hold the Phial of Quenched Embers. Shipwreck treasure, large ocean ruins, and rare trail ruins can surrender the Pendant of the Drowned Choir.
